meta.parties: Archbishop of Colombo v. Don Alexander

rules.statement: Clause 21 of the will did not create a valid fideicommissum and provided for only one grade of fidei commissaries.
rules.supporting_quote: "I therefore take the view that clause 21 did not create a valid fideicommissum, and that the testator intended the appropriate shares in the Madampitiya property to vest absolutely, and without further restrictions, in each institute (or his substitute, as the case may be)."
